items.t: Arbutus, Vancouver: 31 houses sold at a median of $3,099,000, with the middle half between $2,770,000 and $3,489,000. The median house took 15 days to sell and closed at 94.7% of list.

11 duplexes sold in Arbutus, Vancouver at a median of $2,075,000 (middle half $1,936,500 to $2,219,048). A typical duplex in Arbutus, Vancouver spent 17 days on the market and closed at 98.2% of the asking price.

blocks.text: Source: Paragon closed sales, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026; medians need 5 or more sales.
How Arbutus compares with the rest of Vancouver West

items.t: Houses in Arbutus have the 6th highest median of 17 Vancouver West sub-areas, $3,099,000. University is lowest at $1,549,000 and Shaughnessy highest at $4,817,500. South Cambie ($3,075,000) sits just below and Kerrisdale ($3,136,500) sits just above.

Of 9 Vancouver West sub-areas with 5 or more duplex sales, Arbutus ranks 4th highest at $2,075,000; the range is $1,435,000 (Marpole) to $2,398,500 (Cambie). Kitsilano ($2,057,500) sits just below and Kerrisdale ($2,200,000) sits just above.

blocks.text: By build year, duplexes are the newest homes selling in Arbutus, Vancouver (median 2025) and houses the oldest (median 1993), a gap of 32 years.
No single Arbutus, Vancouver condo building or townhome complex had 3 or more resales over the past year, so none is named here.
